cases.title: Add Bookmark to Specific Location
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be successfully added to a specified folder within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Delete Bookmark Completely
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are properly deleted from the bookmarks file and are no longer displayed from any UI access point.

cases.title: Personal Toolbar Add and Delete
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be added to and deleted from the personal toolbar successfully.

cases.title: Insert New Bookmark Folder
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be inserted into the bookmarks hierarchy at a valid level.

cases.title: Launch Bookmark via Double-Click
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Default Bookmarks Link Validity
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks within the default bookmarks file packaged with the browser are valid links.

cases.title: Save Bookmark Modifications with Integrity
cases.description: Verify that changes made to a bookmark item are saved correctly without loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder can be deleted along with its contents or handled according to hierarchy rules.

cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmark Separators
cases.description: Verify that bookmark separators can be added into the list and subsequently deleted.

cases.title: Persistence of Bookmark Changes
cases.description: Verify that bookmark changes are saved and persisted across browser restarts and simulated crashes.

cases.title: Negative Test for View Properties
cases.description: Verify that view properties behave correctly (negative test) for bookmarks, folders, and separators.

cases.title: Inline Renaming of Bookmarks
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be renamed inline directly in the UI without using the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Find Bookmark Using Custom Keyword
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be found and resolved using user-defined custom keywords.

cases.title: Sort and Reverse-Sort Bookmarks
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be sorted and reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns are resizable to show or hide more entry details.

cases.title: Show and Hide Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that individual bookmark columns can be shown and hidden via user controls.

cases.title: Bulk Deletion of Multiple Bookmarks
cases.description: Verify that several bookmarks can be selected and deleted simultaneously at one time.

cases.title: Prevent Invalid Bookmark Drop Actions
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself, or onto its immediate parent or child.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases cover all requirements clearly, distinctly, and logically. No blockers or untestable ambiguities were identified.
All test cases map correctly to their respective requirements and are clear, testable, and follow the specified guidelines without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: R-001: Testable behavior: Adding a bookmark to a specific hierarchy location. Boundaries: Valid/invalid folder paths, root vs subfolder. Normal path: Successful addition. Abnormal path: Non-existent target location. Ambiguity: Exact definition of 'specific location'. R-002: Testable behavior: Deleting a bookmark from file and all UI access points. Boundaries: Single/multiple access points. Normal path: Complete removal. Abnormal path: Orphaned entries remaining in UI/file. Ambiguity: None. R-003: Testable behavior: Adding/deleting bookmarks via the personal toolbar. Boundaries: Toolbar capacity limits. Normal path: Drag-and-drop or menu add/delete. Abnormal path: Adding invalid URIs. Ambiguity: None. R-004: Testable behavior: Inserting new bookmark folders into the hierarchy. Boundaries: Nested folder depth. Normal path: Folder creation at valid level. Abnormal path: Creating duplicate folder names if restricted. Ambiguity: None. R-005: Testable behavior: Launching bookmarks via double-click. Boundaries: Single vs double click. Normal path: Opens URL in browser window. Abnormal path: Malformed URLs. Ambiguity: Background vs foreground window. R-006: Testable behavior: Default packaged bookmarks contain valid links. Boundaries: All default links checked. Normal path: 200 OK responses. Abnormal path: Broken links (404/DNS errors). Ambiguity: Handling of redirects. R-007: Testable behavior: Saving modifications to bookmark items without integrity loss. Boundaries: Field length limits (name, URL, keyword). Normal path: Edit and save properties. Abnormal path: Corrupted data write on disk full. Ambiguity: Definition of item integrity. R-008: Testable behavior: Deleting a bookmarks folder. Boundaries: Empty vs non-empty folders (cascade delete). Normal path: Folder removed. Abnormal path: Deleting locked/system folders. Ambiguity: Whether contents are deleted recursively or orphaned. R-009: Testable behavior: Adding and deleting bookmark separators. Boundaries: Position limits (e.g., start/end of list). Normal path: Separator added/removed correctly. Abnormal path: Multiple consecutive separators. Ambiguity: None. R-010: Testable behavior: Persistence of bookmark changes across restarts and crashes. Boundaries: Clean exit vs abrupt process kill. Normal path: Changes retained after restart. Abnormal path: State recovery after crash. Ambiguity: Crash simulation method. R-011: Testable behavior: View properties negative testing for bookmarks, folders, and separators. Boundaries: Unsupported property requests. Normal path: Action correctly blocked or errors handled. Abnormal path: Unexpected property dialog opening. Ambiguity: Specific negative behavior expected. R-012: Testable behavior: Inline renaming of bookmarks. Boundaries: Special characters in names. Normal path: Rename via UI without properties dialog. Abnormal path: Empty name submission. Ambiguity: Trigger action for inline rename (e.g., F2 or slow double-click). R-013: Testable behavior: Finding bookmarks using custom keywords. Boundaries: Unique vs duplicate keywords. Normal path: Keyword resolves to bookmark URL. Abnormal path: Non-existent keyword lookup. Ambiguity: Behavior on duplicate keywords. R-014: Testable behavior: Sorting and reverse-sorting bookmarks per column. Boundaries: Alphabetical, date added, etc. Normal path: Column click toggles asc/desc sort. Abnormal path: Sorting with null values. Ambiguity: None. R-015: Testable behavior: Resizing bookmark columns. Boundaries: Min/max column widths. Normal path: Drag column border to resize. Abnormal path: Resizing below zero or infinite width. Ambiguity: None. R-016: Testable behavior: Showing and hiding bookmark columns. Boundaries: Minimum required visible columns. Normal path: Toggle column visibility via context menu. Abnormal path: Hiding all columns. Ambiguity: None. R-017: Testable behavior: Bulk deletion of multiple bookmarks simultaneously. Boundaries: Selecting single, multiple, or all items. Normal path: Multi-select and delete. Abnormal path: Deleting unselected or empty selection. Ambiguity: None. R-018: Testable behavior: Preventing drop of bookmark onto itself, immediate parent, or child. Boundaries: Self, parent, child nodes. Normal path: Drop rejected with visual cue. Abnormal path: Allowing circular reference loops. Ambiguity: Definition of immediate child/parent vs descendants.
